Multiple Tornadoes Confirmed in Canadian Prairies Storm

Researchers have confirmed that four tornadoes touched down in the Canadian Prairies during a recent storm. Three of these tornadoes were specifically confirmed in Manitoba, with one impacting the Saskatchewan/Manitoba border region. The storm also caused damage to corn crops and tore the roof off a home in Windsor. The Northern Tornadoes Project is investigating the events.
